Congress Leaders Told to Avoid Statements Praising BJP

Congress General Secretary K.C. Venugopal has instructed party leaders to refrain from making statements that could be perceived as pleasing the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). This directive follows remarks made by MP Shashi Tharoor regarding Rahul Gandhi's student outreach program. Venugopal emphasized the need for caution and unity within the party, suggesting that such statements could inadvertently benefit the opposition. The internal communication aims to prevent internal discord and maintain a unified front.
